dwell_ms.description: How long gaze must settle on a block before it is lit (ms).

stuck_factor.description: A reader is stuck when they stay longer than expected reading time times this factor.

min_stuck_ms.description: Floor for the stuck timer so short paragraphs do not trigger instantly (ms).

reading_wpm.description: Assumed comfortable reading speed, words per minute.

cloud_model.description: Cloud model used when Gemini Nano is unavailable and for chart explanations.

prefetch_on_device.description: Speculatively prepare paragraph help on-device when a reader settles (only when Nano is ready).
